'''''Galactic Defense Review''''' was a publication in circulation prior to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. An [[Introducing Incom's T-65 "X-Wing" Space Superiority Fighter|advertisement]] for [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] could be found in copies of ''Galactic Defense Review'' that had been published before the corporation had been [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalized]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="RPG" /> It also gave the [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] a rating of "unacceptable" for thrust-to-mass ratio when it was first announced.<ref name="Alt">{{JournalCite|5|A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships}}</ref>
